title: Design System Utilities Manifest
description: Schema for utility/style preset manifests consumed by the DS Language Server and documentation tools. Supports multi-platform output (CSS classes, SwiftUI modifiers, Compose styles, etc.).

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when this manifest was generated

prefix.description: Common name prefix for this category (e.g. 'ds-text-heading-')

name.description: Utility identifier. For web-only manifests, this is the full CSS class name (e.g. 'ds-text-heading-1'). For multi-platform manifests, use a platform-agnostic name and provide platform-specific references in 'platforms'.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the utility does

platforms.description: Platform-specific implementations. Keys are platform identifiers (e.g. 'web', 'ios', 'android').

properties.description: CSS property-value pairs this utility generates (web). Shorthand for platforms.web.properties.

tokens.description: Token IDs or CSS custom properties referenced by this utility

deprecated.description: Deprecation info, or null if not deprecated

PlatformUtility.description: How a utility is expressed on a specific platform.

style.description: Compose style or Android resource reference (Android)

properties.description: Platform-specific property-value pairs this utility generates

message.description: Human-readable deprecation reason and migration guidance

removal.description: When the item will be removed. ISO date (2026-07-30), semver (4.0.0), or quarter (Q3-2026)

replacement.description: Machine-readable replacement (utility name to use instead)
